description: Source code for parsing command-line options in a Git-related project, including callback functions for various option types and utility functions for handling options.

methods.name: parse_opt_abbrev_cb
methods.description: Callback to parse abbreviation option, sets integer value based on argument.

methods.name: parse_opt_expiry_date_cb
methods.description: Callback to parse expiry date option, sets timestamp or handles 'never'.

methods.name: parse_opt_color_flag_cb
methods.description: Callback to parse color flag, sets enum value for color output.

methods.name: parse_opt_verbosity_cb
methods.description: Callback to parse verbosity level, adjusts integer counter.

methods.name: parse_opt_commits
methods.description: Parses commit object(s) from argument, inserts into list.

methods.name: parse_opt_commit
methods.description: Parses a single commit object from argument.

methods.name: parse_opt_object_name
methods.description: Parses object name(s) and appends to oid array.

methods.name: parse_opt_object_id
methods.description: Parses object ID and sets target.

methods.name: parse_opt_tertiary
methods.description: Sets target value to 1 or 2 based on unset.

methods.name: parse_options_count
methods.description: Counts number of options in an array.

methods.name: parse_opt_passthru
methods.description: Recreates option string and stores in char*.

methods.name: parse_opt_passthru_argv
methods.description: Recreates option string and appends to strvec.

methods.name: parse_opt_tracking_mode
methods.description: Parses tracking mode option, sets enum accordingly.
